description: This file defines a shared informer for the ClusterTestType custom resource in Kubernetes, including functions to create and manage informers with various options, and interfaces for accessing informer and lister functionalities.

classes.name: clusterTestTypeInformer
classes.description: Implementation of the ClusterTestTypeInformer interface, managing shared informer factory and list options.

methods.name: NewClusterTestTypeInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for ClusterTestType with default options.

methods.name: NewFilteredClusterTestTypeInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for ClusterTestType with custom list options.

methods.name: NewClusterTestTypeInformerWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for ClusterTestType with additional customizable options.

methods.name: defaultInformer
methods.description: Returns the default shared informer with namespace indexer and custom list options.

methods.name: Informer
methods.description: Returns the shared index informer for ClusterTestType.

methods.name: Lister
methods.description: Returns a lister for ClusterTestType resources.
